tracesTo: SOW: Commissioner Desk & Weekly Content Publishing

stories.title: Detect NFL Stat Corrections via Scheduled Data Sync
stories.goal: automatically detect when NFL stat corrections occur that change fantasy matchup outcomes
stories.benefit: predictions and pick'ems are regraded with accurate final results after official stat corrections
acceptanceCriteria: System runs stat correction detection job every 4 hours during NFL season (Sunday through Wednesday)
Detection job calls Sleeper API GET /league/{league_id}/matchups/{week} and compares with previously stored scores
System identifies stat corrections by detecting score changes for matchups that already had 'final' status
Detection algorithm calculates score differentials and determines if winner changed due to stat correction
System flags affected matchups with 'stat_corrected' status and creates stat_correction_log entry with before/after scores
Detection only processes weeks within 72-hour stat correction window (current week and previous 2 weeks)
System triggers immediate cascade workflow when stat corrections detected affecting graded content
Detection logs include timestamp, affected matchup IDs, score changes (before → after), winner changes (if any)
System sends internal notification to admin dashboard when stat corrections detected for monitoring
Detection respects Sleeper API rate limits with exponential backoff and request queuing

stories.title: Automatically Regrade Commissioner Predictions After Stat Corrections
stories.goal: regrade all commissioner predictions when stat corrections change matchup outcomes
stories.benefit: commissioner prediction statistics remain accurate and reflect true final results
acceptanceCriteria: System initiates regrading workflow automatically when stat corrections detected via cascade trigger
Regrading process fetches all commissioner predictions for affected matchups from predictions table
System compares predicted winner with corrected actual winner from stat_correction_log
System updates prediction records with new grading: correct → incorrect or incorrect → correct
Updated predictions receive 'regraded' flag and stat_correction_timestamp for tracking
System recalculates commissioner's weekly prediction accuracy percentage with corrected grades
Cumulative season and all-time prediction stats are recalculated automatically after regrading
Regrading creates audit trail entries: prediction_id, old_grade, new_grade, reason: 'stat_correction', timestamp
System handles edge case of multiple stat corrections for same matchup with version tracking
Regrading is atomic: all affected predictions updated in single transaction or none are updated

stories.title: Regrade Pick'em Submissions After Stat Corrections
stories.goal: regrade all league member pick'em predictions when stat corrections change matchup outcomes
stories.benefit: pick'em leaderboards reflect accurate results and member prediction stats are correct
acceptanceCriteria: System fetches all pick'em submissions for affected matchups from pickems table
Regrading compares each member's predicted winner with corrected actual winner
System updates pick'em records with new grades and 'regraded' flag
Pick'em points are recalculated if confidence-weighted scoring is enabled in league settings
System recalculates weekly pick'em leaderboard rankings with corrected grades
Member's season-long pick'em stats (total correct, accuracy %) updated automatically
If regrading changes leaderboard positions, system generates position_change events for notifications
System handles bracket pick'ems separately: regrading affects bracket progression if correction changes playoff outcomes
Regrading respects pick'em submission deadlines: only regrades submitted picks, not missed picks
System creates bulk audit trail for all regraded pick'ems with batch_id for tracking related changes

stories.title: Update Leaderboards and Rankings After Stat Correction Cascade
stories.goal: update all affected leaderboards and rankings to reflect regraded predictions and pick'ems
stories.benefit: league members see accurate standings based on final official results
acceptanceCriteria: System recalculates commissioner prediction leaderboard with updated accuracy stats after regrading
Pick'em leaderboard is regenerated with new point totals and accuracy percentages
Weekly leaderboard for affected week is updated with new rankings and position changes
Season-long leaderboard is recalculated incorporating corrected weekly results
System identifies members whose leaderboard position changed due to stat corrections
Position changes are tracked with previous_rank and new_rank for notification generation
Leaderboard updates include 'last_updated' timestamp and 'stat_correction' update_reason
If multiple stat corrections occur for same week, leaderboards update after each correction with versioning
System invalidates leaderboard caches across all pages to ensure immediate visibility of changes
Leaderboard update operation is atomic: all related leaderboards updated in single transaction

stories.title: Generate Stat Correction Notifications for Affected Users
stories.goal: receive notification when stat corrections affect my predictions or leaderboard position
stories.benefit: I understand why my stats or position changed and can review the correction details
acceptanceCriteria: System generates notifications for all users with regraded predictions affected by stat correction
Notification content includes: affected week, matchup details, score change (before → after), grade change
Users whose leaderboard position changed receive separate position change notification with rank movement
Commissioner receives notification summarizing all stat corrections and regrading impact for their published predictions
Notifications link directly to affected content: matchup page, prediction history, leaderboard
System batches notifications by user: single notification covering all affected predictions rather than multiple notifications
Notification preferences respected: users can opt out of stat correction notifications in settings
In-app notifications appear in notification center with 'Stat Correction' badge for easy identification
Email notifications sent only for significant changes: leaderboard position change > 2 ranks or prediction grade flip affecting prizes
Notification includes explanation of stat correction process and link to help article for user education

stories.title: Display Stat Correction Indicators in Feed and History
stories.goal: see visual indicators on content that has been affected by stat corrections
stories.benefit: I understand that results have been updated and can distinguish original from corrected results
acceptanceCriteria: Feed moments for predictions and matchups display 'Stat Corrected' badge when affected by corrections
Badge shows tooltip on hover: 'Results updated due to official NFL stat correction on [date]'
Commissioner prediction feed moments show updated grading with 'Regraded' indicator
Matchup results on Matchups page display stat correction icon next to final scores
Pick'em history page shows 'Regraded' column indicating which picks were affected by corrections
Leaderboard displays 'Updated [timestamp]' with stat correction explanation when positions change
Stat correction details modal accessible from indicators showing before/after scores and affected players
System maintains version history: users can view original grading and corrected grading side-by-side
Stat correction log page (admin/commissioner view) lists all corrections with full audit trail
Visual indicators automatically remove after 7 days to avoid cluttering historical content
System provides RSS feed or webhook for external tools to track stat corrections

stories.title: Handle Cascading Stat Corrections Across Multiple Systems
stories.goal: coordinate stat correction impact across all dependent systems and data structures
stories.benefit: entire application remains consistent when stat corrections propagate through related features
acceptanceCriteria: System uses event-driven architecture with 'stat_correction_detected' event triggering cascade workflow
Cascade workflow orchestrates sequential updates: detect → regrade predictions → regrade pick'ems → update leaderboards → generate notifications
Each cascade step validates completion before proceeding to next step with rollback capability on failure
System maintains cascade_execution_log with step completion status and timestamps for monitoring
If any cascade step fails, system retries up to 3 times with exponential backoff before alerting admin
Cascade updates are idempotent: can be safely retried without duplicate updates or data corruption
System locks affected matchups during cascade to prevent concurrent modifications from manual edits
Cascade completion generates 'stat_correction_cascade_complete' event for dependent systems
System provides admin dashboard showing cascade execution status with step-by-step progress
Cascade metrics tracked: total duration, step durations, affected records count, notification count
System supports manual cascade triggering from admin panel for testing or missed automatic triggers

stories.title: Audit and Report Stat Correction Impact
stories.goal: view comprehensive report of stat correction impact on league activities
stories.benefit: I can communicate changes to league members and verify system correctly processed corrections
acceptanceCriteria: System generates stat correction impact report accessible from Commissioner Desk and admin panel
Report includes summary: number of corrections, affected matchups, total predictions regraded, total pick'ems regraded
Detailed section shows each correction with before/after scores, winner changes, and cascade timeline
Report lists all affected users with their grade changes and leaderboard position movements
Commissioner predictions section shows updated accuracy stats with comparison to pre-correction stats
Pick'em leaderboard changes highlighted with position movement visualization (up/down arrows with magnitude)
Report includes audit trail with all system actions: detection timestamp, regrading timestamps, notification timestamps
System provides downloadable CSV export of stat correction report for record-keeping
Report tracks historical stat corrections across entire season with trend analysis
Commissioners can share report link with league members for transparency on correction handling
Report generation respects data privacy: only shows aggregated data for non-commissioners
